green.note: Ground by day, overscroll, caret, booked courts, Seed numerals, won points, On now.

deep.note: Ground once the Playoff is final and on the results page.

red.note: Shots owed, OPEN, problems and refused saves, destructive confirm border. Only on a slip.

mint.note: PAID stamp with ink text; text selection.

gold.note: Final place numbers only. Its shipped use as the focus outline is an open defect, not a role.

slip.note: Every tab, court card, form, notice; the results' shots plate.

ink.note: Text on slips, control borders, primary button fill, the heavy total rule.

ink-2.note: Secondary text on a slip, about 7:1.

on-green.note: Text on the green; results row rules are white at 20%.

on-green-2.note: Secondary text on the green, about 6.5:1.

title.purpose: The DDD name opening every screen, uppercase.

place.purpose: Gold Final place numbers on the results.

place-team.purpose: The Team in each Final place.

seed.purpose: Bottle-green Seed or place number heading a tab row.

band.purpose: Section heads on the green and Team names atop a Matchup slip.

score.purpose: A Game's points beside each Pair.

team.purpose: Team names in tab rows; DDD names in the list at 1.625rem.

round.purpose: The round the day is in, on the green.

note.purpose: Notes and secondary lines in slip grey.

stamp.purpose: OPEN, PAID, slip headers, a Game's status line. Never data.

stamp-small.purpose: Header fact labels, table heads, Pair legends, On now / Up next labels, Captain tag. Never data.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The world is flat: slips on felt, rules inside.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Every focusable element. Shipped colour is gold (#ffd166), about 1.35:1 on a slip: an open defect, colour not recorded as a rule.

motion.name: print
motion.value: 420ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0), translateY(-6px) to none
motion.purpose: Signature: a new ledger line prints onto the tab. Cut under reduced motion.

motion.name: tick
motion.value: 360ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); translateY(40%) and opacity 0 to none
motion.purpose: A shot total ticks when it changes. Cut under reduced motion.

motion.name: dim
motion.purpose: Up next and later Games and court lines. Static, not animated.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Tight court strip so the first tab lands in the first screen.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Pair slots and Dreambreakers two across.

breakpoints.name: tv
breakpoints.purpose: Public Link as one 1920x1080 screen: 112rem column, courts across the top, tabs beside the Seeding, roster and Spreads hidden.

narrative.overview:
Every Team runs a bar tab all day. A Game missed against the Spread rings up as a line item, the running total ticks, and at dinner the tab settles. The ground is bottle green, like the felt of a bar back or a beer bottle; everything read sits on a white slip with a thin rule between line items, the way a bar prints a tab. Stamp red marks what is owed. When the Playoff is final the ground goes deep green, the dinner light, and the settled tabs carry a PAID or OPEN stamp.

It is openly a party, but readable first. The first Tab sketch was rejected as hard to read, so the type does the work: Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything read or tapped, Anton only for names, totals, scores and place numbers, and Courier Prime only for small stamps and slip headers. Scores and shot counts read at arm's length on a phone under gym light and across a room on a venue TV.

The world refuses both the sports-broadcast scoreboard (Team Tally's) and neon party costume. No cards beyond the slip, no shadows, no rounded panels past a 3px corner. Controls are standard web controls (buttons, text fields, selects, `details`) restyled in ink on paper.
keyCharacteristics: Bottle green ground by day; deep green once the Playoff is final and on the results.
White slips with 1px rules between line items and a heavy 3px ink rule over a running total.
Stamp red for shots owed, OPEN and refusals; mint for PAID; gold only for Final place numbers.
Anton for names and numbers that count, Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything read or tapped, Courier Prime for stamps and slip headers.
The whole surface sets tabular numerals.
A new line item prints onto the tab and the total ticks; reduced motion cuts both.

rules.name: The Red Means Owed Rule
rules.body: Stamp red marks shots owed, OPEN, and anything refused or unresolved. On now is not red; it moved to bottle green so red keeps its meaning.

rules.name: The Red Sits On Paper Rule
rules.body: Red text appears on a slip, never directly on either green. On the results the shot count gets its own slip plate so the red still reads at dinner.

rules.name: The Gold Is For Places Rule
rules.body: Gold sets the Final place numbers 1 to 4 and nothing else in the palette's roles.

rules.name: The Paid Means Nothing Owed Rule
rules.body: Nobody records shots as drunk, so a settled tab stamps PAID at 0 shots and OPEN otherwise.

rules.name: The Three Faces Rule
rules.body: Anton for what is counted or named big (Team names, totals, scores, Seed and place numbers, section heads). Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything read or tapped. Courier Prime for stamps, slip headers and header fact labels, never for data: a court name inside a status line drops back to Atkinson at 0.9375rem, and so does the round on the green.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `.ddd-surface` sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, so a total going from 9 to 10 never shifts its column.

rules.name: The TV Rule
rules.body: At 100rem (1600px) and wider the Public Link is one 1920x1080 screen nobody scrolls: a 112rem column, every court across the top in one row, then the tabs ("Shots so far", then "Final places") beside the Seeding in two columns. Before Round 2 there are no tabs, so the Dreambreakers sit beside the Seeding. A round's Matchups go two across. The roster and the Spreads stay on the phones and are hidden on the TV.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Below 100rem every DDD screen is one centred column: 40rem, or 72rem on the results.

rules.name: The Paper On Felt Rule
rules.body: A slip is the only surface. No shadows, no lifted panels, no nested cards; inside a slip, line items are divided by rules.

rules.name: The Restyle Not Replace Rule
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, selects, links and `details` stay native controls dressed as ink on paper. No custom pickers or faux controls.

rules.name: The Print And Tick Rule
rules.body: The one signature motion is a line item printing onto a tab and its total ticking. Nothing else animates.

dos: Do set every tab, court, form and notice on a slip (#fbfbf8, 3px corner, no shadow) on the bottle green (#24563f).
Do turn the ground deep green (#10241b) once the Playoff is final and on the results.
Do score each Game once, on its Matchup's slip, with its ledger line under it and a 3px ink rule over the running total.
Do keep red (#d0342c) for shots owed, OPEN and refusals, and set it only on a slip.
Do stamp PAID in mint at 0 shots and OPEN in red otherwise.
Do dim Up next Games to 72% and give them "Enter its final" instead of a form.
Do lay the Public Link out as one unscrolled screen from 100rem: courts across the top, tabs beside the Seeding.
Do cut the print and tick under reduced motion.
donts: Don't set data (names, courts, rounds, scores) in Courier Prime; it is for stamps, slip headers and header fact labels.
Don't put a line above the title or above a Matchup's Team names; the app name is the tab title, not a kicker.
Don't use gold for anything but Final place numbers, or red for On now or decoration.
Don't split a Game across two Team tabs, or number tabs TAB 01.
Don't add shadows, pills, rounded panels past 3px, or cards inside a slip.
Don't bring in Team Tally's broadcast scoreboard or neon party costume.
